name: Telegram Channel Forwarder Bot
description: A customizable Telegram bot that forwards messages from a source channel to a destination channel with text filtering and image processing capabilities.

env.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Your Telegram bot token obtained from BotFather

env.name: SOURCE_CHANNEL_ID
env.description: ID of the channel to forward messages from (e.g., -1001234567890)

env.name: DESTINATION_CHANNEL_ID
env.description: ID of the channel to forward messages to (e.g., -1001098765432)
